content.rendered:
Boxed resistors
Boxed resistors play a key role in power management in industrial infrastructures and high-performance electrical systems. Designed to dissipate excess energy and regulate current in large capacity circuits, these resistors ensure safe and efficient operation in demanding applications.
In environments where large volumes of electricity are handled, such as power plants, substations and distribution systems, the use of a boxed resistor provides overload control and protects equipment from voltage variations. Its robust design and high thermal capacity ensure stable performance even under extreme conditions, extending the life of the electrical infrastructure.

Among their benefits are helping to regulate current and stabilize voltage, which prevents unnecessary energy peaks that can generate cost overruns in electricity billing. In addition, in power backup systems and load banks, boxed resistors allow excess energy to be discharged in a controlled manner, avoiding waste and optimizing the system’s operating capacity.

What is a boxed resistor? What are its functions in large infrastructures?

A boxed resistor is an electrical component designed to dissipate energy in the form of heat, functioning as a controlled load in electrical and industrial circuits. Its structure is encapsulated in a rugged housing, usually made of aluminum or ceramic materials, which allows it to withstand demanding conditions, such as high temperatures, vibrations and humidity.
Overload protection
Acts as a current regulator, preventing damage to transformers, motors and other critical equipment.
Optimization of energy consumption
Dissipates excess energy in a controlled manner, avoiding waste and improving the efficiency of the electrical system.
Versatility in industrial applications
Used in load banks, motor braking, harmonic filtering and electrical equipment testing.
Easy integration into complex electrical systems
Compact and modular design allows easy installation in various electrical configurations.

How do they impact energy distribution?

They improve energy distribution in complex building structures and machinery by absorbing and controlling the flow of electricity, avoiding imbalances that could lead to failures or inefficiencies. In large buildings, where energy demand varies constantly due to the use of elevators, air conditioning systems, lighting and electronic equipment, these resistors ensure that the supply is stable, reducing voltage peaks that could damage the electrical infrastructure or increase unnecessary consumption.
In industry, their function is key in automation processes and high-performance machinery, where they allow adjusting the power used by electric motors and control systems. Their ability to dissipate excess energy prevents overheating and their encapsulated design makes them ideal for demanding environments, ensuring reliable performance even under intensive working conditions.

Torivac is a company specialized in the design and manufacture of toroidal transformers and voltage regulators.

We have nearly 60 years of experience in the sector, which has allowed us to grow to a presence in more than 30 countries.
We have a technical team that guarantees the manufacture of high precision and efficient devices. Our work methodology allows us to perform advanced simulations in each phase of each project, ensuring that each component, from toroidal voltage variators, adjustable transformers, battery dischargers, potentiometers and toroidal cores, meet the highest industry standards.
We work closely with companies that have a large infrastructure, seeking to ensure customized and efficient solutions. We aim to respond to the demands of industries such as technology, energy and automotive. Our goal is to continue innovating, strengthening strategic alliances and expanding our global reach, always maintaining the seal of quality and excellence that has characterized us since our beginnings.

excerpt.rendered:
Ideal for applications such as variable speed and frequency drives, cranes, industrial automation, motor control, dynamic braking, renewable energies (such as wind and solar) and both loading and unloading, these boxed resistors consist of a helical tubular resistor. That is, it is a ceramic tube with a high degree of thermal dissipation and mechanical strength inside a galvanized sheet metal box IP20 and properly perforated for proper ventilation.

This type of boxed resistors is manufactured according to the characteristics requested by the customer, customizing the boxed resistor with a cemented coiled tubular resistor or helical coiled tubular resistor; a high degree of thermal dissipation and a “thermal protector”; an ohmic value according to specification and a Gearless mode or silent capability.

Boxed resistors achieve a long service life due to the quality of their materials and the precision with which they are manufactured. For this reason, they have a maximum temperature of the hottest point on the surface of the resistor at rated power of 375°C and a working voltage of approximately 1 000 v.a.c.

High power cemented resistors

The high-power cemented resistors’ robust design and high load-bearing capacity make them the ideal solution for industrial systems and large power structures.
Manufactured with a ceramic core coated with fire-resistant cement, these resistors ensure high durability and thermal resistance. Their structure prevents overheating and improves operational safety in demanding environments. Due to their ability to handle high power, their basic functions are to optimize the performance of electrical equipment, reduce failures and extend the service life of systems.

How do you optimize energy distribution in highly complex building structures and machinery?

In the energy sector, these resistors are key for current regulation in distribution networks, substations and high voltage equipment. They also play a key role in large-scale motor control and load balancing in electrical infrastructures, preventing overloads and ensuring efficient operation.
Their accuracy and stability allow them to be adapted to multiple configurations, offering resistance values suitable for every need. This makes them ideal for applications that demand high power without compromising safety and system efficiency.
In the industrial sector, they optimize the performance of heavy machinery, braking systems and automation processes, preventing overheating and extending the useful life of equipment. Thanks to their compact and rugged design, they offer a reliable and durable solution, capable of operating in demanding conditions without compromising safety.

How does it work within a highly demanding electrical system?

They work in conjunction with toroidal transformers and voltage stabilizers to ensure balanced and safe power distribution in industrial and commercial systems. In the case of toroidal transformers, they help dissipate excess current and prevent overloads, ensuring that the output voltage remains stable and without voltage surges or dips that could damage connected equipment.
In voltage stabilizers, these resistors play a key role by absorbing current spikes caused by magnetization of systems, protecting sensitive devices such as precision machinery, servers and medical equipment. They ensure that the power flow is constant and safe, contributing to the operational stability of electrical infrastructures and improving the efficiency of energy consumption.

excerpt.rendered:
Our high power cemented resistors are manufactured from high quality resistive alloy wire. The ohmic value varies little with the temperature rise of the element.

These are wound resistors composed of a resistive element wound on a ceramic tubular core used as a support and coated with a resin to ensure high dissipation capacity and excellent resistance to thermal shock and overload. It is a low inductance open element that allows very low ohmic values.

Its construction allows high power dissipation in a reduced space. This set, with lateral supports and galvanized steel case perforated to ensure proper ventilation, complies with the IP20 or IP23 protection requirement (depending on the resistor model). They can be supplied with thermal protector and with the ohmic value required by the customer.

Low temperature coefficient offering a constant ohmic value over a wide temperature range. Power resistors, being passive elements, are not affected by specific EMC standards. They do not produce interfering radiation and are not affected by it.

The characteristics of our products make our resistors particularly suitable for limiting strong currents, battery discharge, etc.

What are helical resistors?

Helical resistors are electrical components manufactured with a conductive wire wound in a spiral shape around an insulating or ceramic core, which allows them to withstand high energy loads and dissipate heat efficiently. Their helical structure facilitates a uniform distribution of electrical current, reducing the risk of hot spots and improving their performance under demanding conditions.
They are essential in applications such as industrial braking systems, load banks, automated machinery and power controls in production processes.

What is a helical resistor?

The spiral design allows uniform heat distribution, optimizing performance in large-scale electrical systems and advanced power structures.
Manufactured with high thermal conductivity materials and protected with corrosion-resistant coatings, these resistors ensure stable operation even under extreme conditions. Their helical structure not only improves heat dissipation, but also reduces the possibility of overloads, extending equipment life and reducing the need for frequent maintenance.
Enables high power dissipation in a small space. This set, with side supports and galvanized steel box perforated to ensure proper ventilation, complies with the IP20 or IP23 protection requirement. They can be supplied with thermal protector and with the ohmic value required by the customer.
Low temperature coefficient offering a constant ohmic value (temperature dependent parameter) over a wide temperature range. The power resistors, being passive elements, are not affected by specific EMC standards.

In the industrial field, helical heaters are essential in heating systems, electric furnaces, processing machinery and power distribution networks. excerpt.rendered:
Braking resistors are intended to dissipate the energy generated by a motor during deceleration, preventing damage to the drive due to overvoltage and ensuring that it stops safely.

TORIVAC is a manufacturer of different types of dynamic braking resistors, which offer an economical and small size solution for braking control by absorbing and dissipating energy efficiently and effectively. A braking resistor helps to slow down or stop a motor by dissipating the excess voltage generated by the decelerating motor.

These resistors can also help reduce wear on braking components, which can extend equipment life, enable faster braking and eliminate the risk of overheating.

– Suitable for any application requiring dynamic braking.
– Suitable for power from 1W to 100MW and duty cycle from 1% to 100%.
– Suitable for all types of frequency inverters

– Manufacture according to customer specifications

– Small size range at very competitive prices.

– They can be supplied in air (IP00 or in enclosure (from IP20 to IP54).

title.rendered: Rheostats and potentiometers, wound special fabrications

content.rendered:
What are Rheostats and Wound Potentiometers and why are they important?

Rheostats and potentiometer windings are variable resistance devices designed to regulate the voltage in an electrical circuit, adjusting the power supplied to a system.

The rheostat is mainly used in electric motors, load banks and industrial control systems, where it is necessary to modify the resistance to manage the power flow. In contrast, the wound potentiometer acts as a voltage divider, allowing the electrical signal to be adjusted in calibration equipment, speed controls and measuring devices.

Specially manufactured rheostats and coiled potentiometers offer a tailor-made solution for voltage regulation and power management in critical infrastructures, optimizing the performance of electrical systems and extending the lifetime of equipment.

These devices allow fine adjustments in current, improving operational stability in motors, generators and power distribution systems. Their customizability makes them ideal for adapting to any specific application, ensuring optimum performance under demanding conditions.
They are essential for speed control of industrial motors, current regulation in electrical systems and load simulation in test benches. In large power structures, their use minimizes energy losses, improves system efficiency and avoids overloads, ensuring reliable and continuous operation.

Effective solution for every industrial application

The use of rheostats and wound potentiometers is a key strategy for optimizing energy consumption in industrial environments. By regulating the current intensity in a controlled manner, overheating is avoided and the stability of the electrical system is improved. This adjustability contributes to more efficient energy management.
Rheostats allow the starting and operating power to be adjusted, avoiding current peaks that can damage equipment. This is especially useful in heavy machinery, elevators and automated production systems.
Wound potentiometers are essential in calibration, measurement and precision control systems, ensuring that the power supplied to sensors, regulators and test equipment is adequate for proper operation.

Torivac is a company specialized in the design and manufacture of toroidal transformers and voltage regulators.

We have nearly 60 years of experience in the sector, which has allowed us to grow to a presence in more than 30 countries.
We have a technical team that guarantees the manufacture of high precision and efficient devices. Our work methodology allows us to perform advanced simulations in each phase of each project, ensuring that each component, from toroidal voltage variators, adjustable transformers, battery dischargers, potentiometers and toroidal cores, meet the highest industry standards.
We work closely with companies that have a large infrastructure, seeking to ensure customized and efficient solutions. We aim to respond to the demands of industries such as technology, energy and automotive. Our goal is to continue innovating, strengthening strategic alliances and expanding our global reach, always maintaining the seal of quality and excellence that has characterized us since our beginnings.

content.rendered:
Role of grounding resistors in electrical systems

Grounding resistors play a key role in the protection and safety of electrical installations, especially in high-voltage industrial environments. In areas where electrical regulation is critical, as is the case in much of Europe, these devices ensure ground potential control and limit fault current during lightning strikes or short circuits. Their main function is to introduce a carefully calculated impedance between the system neutral and earth, allowing energy to be safely dissipated and maintaining the integrity of the electrical system in the event of sudden faults. This type of solution is systematically integrated in industrial plants, power distribution centers and critical infrastructure networks, where high operational continuity and technical reliability are required.

In the most industrialized countries of the continent, such as Germany, there is a great demand for high efficiency grounding resistors manufactured under strict European standards. These conditions make it essential to have access to specialized manufacturers that can guarantee regulatory compliance, international certifications and effective technical support. The correct implementation of these elements not only prevents damage to equipment, but also protects technical personnel and avoids interruptions in the electrical network, reducing economic losses and increasing the operational efficiency of the entire system. The right choice of this equipment depends not only on technical specifications, but also on the supplier’s knowledge of European environmental and electrical regulations.

 

We are specialized distributors in voltage regulation

The European market presents considerable technical complexity when it comes to the distribution of elements for the variation and regulation of electrical voltage. Companies responsible for electrical installations for civil or industrial sectors, such as those working on complex wiring systems, integration of variable frequency drives, or implementation of solutions in energy storage centers, often face obstacles when trying to procure grounding resistors with suitable specifications. The technical needs of these projects require precisely developed products, and in contrast, the number of distributors able to offer expert advice and direct supply in Europe remains minimal.

This highlights the challenge of finding suppliers that not only distribute components, but also manufacture them, know the complete production cycle and can adapt to particular requirements.

Current reality shows that many solutions come from intermediaries that raise costs and dilute quality control. Against this backdrop, direct access to manufacturers with in-house knowledge of design, testing and validation processes is decisive. Moreover, in a context where increasing energy efficiency and complying with safety regulations are indispensable, having equipment developed from a solid technical base becomes a non-negotiable priority. Grounding resistors, when selected with appropriate technical criteria, ensure stable electrical systems, reduce operational risks and comply with legislation that varies subtly between countries such as Germany, France or the Netherlands.

 

Technical advantages of “grounding resistors” manufactured by Torivac

Unlike many companies that operate solely as intermediaries, Torivac designs and manufactures its own grounding resistors, allowing comprehensive control over the electrical, mechanical and thermal parameters of each unit. This provides a clear advantage to system integrators who need customized answers, fast delivery and flexibility in design according to local regulations or integration requirements with SCADA systems and industrial automation. The solutions offered by Torivac are tested in controlled environments, using European-level quality methodologies and certified materials to ensure stable performance in leakage current, thermal resistance and power dissipation ranges.

The decision to maintain an in-house production line not only ensures consistent standards, but also significantly reduces costs, making it possible to offer grounding resistors with a better price-quality ratio than what is usually found on the market. Companies in the energy sector, automated logistics centers, battery storage facilities or industrial pumping systems will find in Torivac a technical supplier able to collaborate closely from design to commissioning. Detail-oriented technical support, in-depth knowledge of European standards such as EN 50522 and the ability to supply in large volumes complete an ideal profile for those looking for long-term strategic suppliers.

 

Safety and efficiency of products manufactured directly in Europe

Choosing a supplier like Torivac means much more than simply acquiring an electrical component. It means establishing a relationship of trust with a manufacturer that is committed to technical excellence and responsibility in every unit it delivers. In a highly demanding and regulated European context, especially in markets such as Germany and the Nordic countries, offering locally designed and manufactured grounding resistors represents a real competitive advantage. Each component is developed to integrate precisely into complex control schemes, withstand variable voltages and offer high repeatability under permanently demanding conditions. The direct approach between manufacturer and customer also means improved traceability, product customization according to project needs and a significant reduction in delivery times.

Torivac is not just another distribution point, but positions itself as a technical partner, with an industrial vision and global knowledge of the applications where its solutions add value. Many projects in the railway, power generation and automated logistics sectors have already integrated grounding resistors developed by Torivac, benefiting from products whose design, price and efficiency are oriented to long-term European standards. With its own technology and absolute operational commitment, Torivac is a point of reference for companies that understand that electrical components must not only be functional, but precisely designed to ensure continuity, safety and sustained economic return.

Neutral grounding resistors are especially recommended for the protection of power transformers and generators in case of ground faults in medium and low voltage electrical distribution networks.

Our custom-made grounding resistors, equipped with a current transformer, offer a high thermal capacity to absorb large currents. Our resistors can also integrate all types of accessories (switches, contactors, control elements, terminal boxes, etc.).

title.rendered: Inverter for photovoltaic connection to the grid

content.rendered:
What is an Inverter for photovoltaic grid connection?

A photovoltaic grid-tie inverter is a device that converts the power generated by solar panels into usable electricity for consumption or injection into the electrical grid. Solar panels produce direct current (DC), but most electrical systems and appliances run on alternating current (AC), so the inverter is essential to adapt the power and make it compatible with the electrical infrastructure.
Torivac’s PV grid-tie inverter is an essential component for companies looking to integrate solar power into their daily operations. This device converts the direct current generated by solar panels into alternating current, allowing its direct use in industrial and commercial installations.

How does this device perform in a highly demanding power system?

In industrial, commercial or large infrastructure installations, where energy demand is high, the inverter works in real time adjusting the energy conversion according to the required consumption. It integrates a maximum power point tracking system (MPPT), which allows extracting the maximum performance from the solar panels under variable conditions such as changes in radiation or temperature.

When PV production exceeds consumption, the inverter can redirect surplus energy to the grid or store it in batteries, depending on the system installed. This is crucial in sectors that operate with high energy loads, as it helps reduce dependence on the conventional grid, lower costs and improve operational efficiency.
In addition, in critical systems such as hospitals, factories and data centers, the high-capacity inverter incorporates advanced protections against power surges or dips and power outages, ensuring that essential equipment continues to operate without interruption.

Benefits in controlling energy input and output

1. Reduction of energy costs

The inverter allows the energy generated by the solar panels to be consumed directly in the installations, reducing the purchase of electricity from the grid. This significantly reduces the electricity bill, especially in industries with high consumption, such as manufacturing and agribusiness. In addition, by taking advantage of a free source such as solar energy, the return on investment of the photovoltaic system is accelerated, allowing the initial cost to be amortized in less time.

2. Stability and reliability of power supply

Fluctuations in the grid can affect industrial production, causing outages or damage to sensitive equipment. Torivac’s inverter efficiently manages solar power conversion, stabilizing the voltage and ensuring a constant supply, even in conditions of low solar generation. This stability is key in sectors such as data centers, hospitals and automated production plants, where any variation in power can affect operation.

3.Compatibility with energy monitoring and management systems.

Torivac’s inverter is compatible with real-time monitoring platforms, allowing companies to control production and energy consumption from any location. This is essential for industries with multiple plants or large production areas, as it allows for monitoring power surges and dips.

Torivac is a company specialized in the design and manufacture of toroidal transformers and voltage regulators
We have nearly 60 years of experience in the industry, which has allowed us to grow to a presence in more than 30 countries.
We have a technical team that guarantees the manufacture of high precision and efficient devices. Our work methodology allows us to perform advanced simulations in each phase of each project, ensuring that each component, from toroidal voltage variators, adjustable transformers, battery dischargers, potentiometers and toroidal cores, meet the highest standards in the industry.
We work closely with companies that have a large infrastructure, seeking to ensure customized and efficient solutions. We aim to respond to the demands of industries such as technology, energy and automotive. Our goal is to continue innovating, strengthening strategic alliances and expanding our global reach, always maintaining the seal of quality and excellence that has characterized us since our beginnings.

Technical Details

  • Dynamic maximum power point search (MPPT).
  • Minimum generation power for MPPT operation: 20W.
  • Minimum generation power to inject energy into the grid: 3W.
  • Pure sine wave, THD<3%.
  • Consumption in standby < 1W.
  • Over-temperature protection by maximum power regulation.
  • Automatic adaptation to the characteristics of the F.V. field.
  • Maximum yield 95%.
  • Admitted mains voltage range : 230V ±2%.
  • Supported mains frequency range: 50Hz ±0.02%.
  • Disconnection time in case of power failure or opening of the network < 5ms.
  • Isolation between V.F. field circuits and mains: 3000V AC 50Hz.
  • V.F. field ground leakage detection.
  • EMC filter for mains connection, ensuring electromagnetic compatibility in compliance with CE standards.
  • Protection against voltage peaks and atmospheric discharges.

 

We use the most advanced power conversion technology. The input stage, equipped with high-efficiency POWER-MOS transistors, converts direct current into high-frequency alternating current, modulated in a sinusoidal manner that closely follows the mains voltage. The isolated power transfer is done through a isolating transformer, which, operating at high frequency, has a higher efficiency than the transformers operating at mains frequency, with a much smaller weight and dimensions
. At the output an IGBT bridge restores the 50Hz frequency, with synchronized switching with the mains.
All inverter functions are controlled by a state-of-the-art flash MICROPROCESSOR. This includes precise tracking of the maximum power point of the PV field. Parameters such as field voltage-current curve, grid voltage and delivered power are constantly measured, readjusting the operating point every few seconds to achieve maximum energy utilization. Grid voltage and frequency are monitored every millisecond, in order to ensure an immediate disconnection of the inverter in case of deviation from the authorized range, or island operation, according to RD 1663/2000.
The fact of being equipped with program flash memory allows to easily make a modification of parameters (if necessary, without removing the unit from the installation) to adapt it to future changes in regulations or specific conditions of the customer.

content.rendered:
What are Torivac’s photovoltaic regulators?

Torivac’s photovoltaic regulators are devices that control the amount of charge going in and out of a solar panel. Their main function is to prevent overcharging and over-discharging of the battery, which can cause damage and reduce battery life.
They feature MPPT technology that automatically adjusts the voltage and current of solar panels to operate at their maximum power point. This process improves conversion efficiency by up to 30%, allowing companies to generate more power without increasing the number of panels installed.
MPPT regulators ensure optimal performance even in conditions of low radiation or sudden changes in solar intensity. In sectors such as agriculture, where solar energy is used for irrigation and processing, maintaining stable production is crucial to avoid operational interruptions.

What is the role of regulators in a photovoltaic system?

Without an MPPT regulator, batteries can be overcharged or completely discharged, which reduces their lifespan and can lead to power failures. A PV regulator avoids these problems by controlling the charging and discharging of the batteries, ensuring a stable and safe power flow.
They can also be integrated into a wide variety of installations, from small PV units to large industrial plants. Their flexibility makes them ideal for sectors with different energy needs, such as manufacturing, mining and logistics.

In sectors where sensitive equipment is used, such as hospitals, data centers or automated factories, any fluctuation in the power supply can cause serious problems, from production system failures to loss of information. An MPPT regulator helps maintain a stable flow of power, protecting expensive equipment and ensuring operational continuity without unexpected interruptions.

Torivac is a company specialized in the design and manufacture of toroidal transformers and voltage regulators.

We have nearly 60 years of experience in the sector, which has allowed us to grow to a presence in more than 30 countries.
We have a technical team that guarantees the manufacture of high precision and efficient devices. Our work methodology allows us to perform advanced simulations in each phase of each project, ensuring that each component, from toroidal voltage variators, adjustable transformers, battery dischargers, potentiometers and toroidal cores, meet the highest industry standards.
We work closely with companies that have a large infrastructure, seeking to ensure customized and efficient solutions. We aim to respond to the demands of industries such as technology, energy and automotive. Our goal is to continue innovating, strengthening strategic alliances and expanding our global reach, always maintaining the seal of quality and excellence that has characterized us since our beginnings.

Technical Details

  • Nominal battery voltages 12V, 24V and 48V.
  • Automatic search for the maximum power point of the photovoltaic modules.
  • Step-up and step-down voltage conversion with a wide range of input voltages.
  • Charge regulation and battery monitoring.
  • Data acquisition and production logging.
  • Battery charging current up to 80A.
  • RS-485 communication port for readings and remote management.
  • Configurable switching relays.
  • Alphanumeric display with voltage, current, active power and consumed energy readings
  • Communications port for remote reading of all parameters.
  • Connections for use in Master-Slave mode.

excerpt.rendered:
The system of double conversion and accumulation of energy in an intermediate bus from direct current to high voltage.
It allows us to work with relatively small batteries for the available power, since the consumption does not suffer the output ripple, and the instantaneous start-up peaks of connected devices are not immediately transferred to the battery because the energy stored in the inverter itself is used.
The output transistor bridge, switching at 20kHz with sinusoidal modulation allows us to obtain a pure output voltage free of harmonics.
All inverter functions are controlled by a dual microcontroller system, which allows for high precision and reliability.

content.rendered:
What are Starting Resistors?

Starting resistors are devices designed to limit the initial current in electric motors at start-up, avoiding current peaks that can damage the system or reduce component life. When a motor starts, it needs a high energy flow to overcome inertia and start turning, which can lead to excessive consumption and premature wear. They are essential for the control and protection of electric motors in large-scale energy and industrial infrastructures.
Its main function is to limit the starting current, reducing voltage peaks and avoiding unnecessary stress on the system. This allows a progressive and safe start-up, optimizing the equipment’s operability and extending its useful life.

Why do large industries need to have starting resistors?

In large energy infrastructures, where energy demand is high and constant, having a solution that guarantees a progressive and efficient start-up is essential for the safety and performance of the equipment.

These starting resistors work by limiting the initial current and reducing the mechanical stress on the motor, preventing overheating and reducing premature wear of components. Their application is essential in industries with large motors, such as power generation plants, pumping systems, mining and heavy manufacturing, where a bad start can generate costly failures and interruptions in operation.

In industrial systems, these resistors work in conjunction with three-phase motors and variable voltage drives, reducing the initial current at start-up and avoiding peaks that could affect performance or damage components. Once the motor reaches its rated speed, the resistors are automatically disconnected, allowing the system to operate with total stability.

We have nearly 60 years of experience in the industry, which has allowed us to grow to a presence in more than 30 countries.
We have a technical team that guarantees the manufacture of high precision and efficient devices. Our work methodology allows us to perform advanced simulations in each phase of each project, ensuring that each component, from toroidal voltage variators, adjustable transformers, battery dischargers, potentiometers and toroidal cores, meet the highest standards in the industry.
We work closely with companies that have a large infrastructure, seeking to ensure customized and efficient solutions. We aim to respond to the demands of industries such as technology, energy and automotive. Our goal is to continue innovating, strengthening strategic alliances and expanding our global reach, always maintaining the seal of quality and excellence that has characterized us since our beginnings.

content.rendered:
Load bank in the European voltage regulation industry
Safety and efficiency of products manufactured directly in Europe

The load bank is an essential component in electrical infrastructures that require testing, validation and testing of energy systems. In the European industrial context, where efficiency, stability and safety in electrical distribution make the competitive difference, this type of resistor assembly acquires key technical relevance. It stands out as a technical solution for simulating real loads and allows effective verification of the quality of generators, inverters and other energy equipment without relying on the load they would have under normal operating conditions. In Europe, especially in countries such as Germany, France or the Netherlands, where regulatory requirements are strict, having a precisely designed load bank raises the standards of internal quality control in many industrial sectors.

The resistors that make up each load bank must meet strict parameters of dissipation, tolerance and resistance to extreme temperatures. Their integration within the test or validation scheme represents not only a technical requirement but an operational necessity. This technical training is especially crucial for energy storage centers, renewable generation infrastructures and test systems in the railway, naval or aerospace industries. The correct use of the load bank makes it possible to detect incipient failures in systems, extend the useful life of equipment and avoid performance deviations in critical projects. In an environment such as the European one, with high technical competence and strong regulatory requirements, implementing a reliable test system is not optional: it is an indispensable condition for staying in the market.

 

Load test benches define the quality of an electrical system.

Load test benches have become an essential tool in industrial facilities operating high voltage electrical systems. Their function goes far beyond simple verification tasks. This equipment allows replicating real operating conditions without compromising the safety and stability of the systems involved. In sectors such as transformer manufacturing, generator testing or backup system maintenance, having accurate and reliable load banks makes a critical difference in operational efficiency and regulatory compliance.

For such industrial customers, electrical validation requirements are determined by factors such as IEC standards or compliance with European safety directives, so the load bank component must be integrated with full technical documentation, material traceability and specific test parameters. Having a supplier to design and manufacture the product is essential, especially if the customer operates under demanding technical conditions or in regulated environments such as renewable energy installations in Germany or industrial efficiency programs in Nordic countries.

 

Direct manufacturers of resistors and load test benches

In environments where significant voltage and current levels are handled, it is essential to have mechanisms that accurately simulate the most demanding scenarios. Load banks are used precisely for this purpose, as they allow electrical equipment to be tested under different conditions without exposing the main infrastructure to unnecessary risks. In this way, electrical engineers can validate the behavior of the systems before they go into final operation or after maintenance interventions.

The load bench developed and produced by Torivac is presented as a robust, durable solution, optimized to operate in critical industrial applications. Moreover, its status as a manufacturer allows it to adapt product parameters in short lead times and with a technical response aligned with the specific requirements of each customer. The excellent relationship between performance, cost and traceability makes Torivac resistors and load banks a safe strategic choice. For projects operating in regulated environments or in sectors heavily stressed by regulatory requirements, having a reliable technical partner is not a matter of preference, but an operational necessity.

 

Torivac manufactures resistors – high precision load banks for critical tests.

Adopting a high-precision load bank not only ensures the reliability of the power system in which it will be installed, but also optimizes preventive maintenance cycles and reduces the risk of failure in critical situations. In the competitive European industrial environment, where every technical deviation can lead to financial losses or contractual reprisals, systems such as those offered by Torivac provide a tangible long-term advantage. Each resistor developed by this firm is manufactured under rigorous technical criteria, aimed at offering solutions with high durability, energy efficiency and regulatory compatibility.

Finally, it is important to note that a well-designed load bench not only improves technical processes, but also conveys an image of commitment to quality and safety. In industries where reliability is everything, demonstrating that you have advanced verification equipment generates confidence in both customers and business partners. This is where Torivac positions itself as a strategic ally, offering solutions that combine technical precision, adaptability and a thorough understanding of the demands of the modern industrial environment.

Trust, precision and long-term technical collaboration are the principles that define Torivac’s value proposition. For companies that face the daily challenge of ensuring the efficiency of their facilities through demanding test systems, choosing a certified, robust and specialist manufactured load bank is not only a measure of quality, but a strategic investment in sustainability and technical reliability. Choosing Torivac is not just another supplier, but one that understands that every resistance manufactured is a technical promise fulfilled.

content.rendered:
Toroidal cores are essential magnetic components in a wide variety of electronic and industrial applications.

Its closed ring design allows an even distribution of magnetic flux, resulting in higher efficiency and a significant reduction of electromagnetic interference (EMI).

In our product range you will find toroidal cores made of high permeability materials such as ferrite, iron powder and amorphous alloys, ideal for:

  • Line filters and noise suppression.
  • Current and power transformers.
  • Energy storage inductors.
  • High frequency and energy efficiency applications.

Thanks to their geometry, toroidal cores minimize hysteresis and eddy current losses, making them the preferred choice for compact, high-performance designs.

We offer standard and customized solutions, adapted to the specific needs of each project. Our technical team is available to advise you on the selection of the most suitable core according to your frequency, power and operating environment requirements.

excerpt.rendered:
The toroidal cores manufactured by Torivac are made of magnetic iron-silicon alloys, grain oriented, with very low losses and high saturation induction which, when heat-treated, improve their magnetic permeability by approximately 40%. The plate qualities used are type M4 or M5, depending on the different applications.
All cores are welded at the beginning and end of the winding, to avoid possible vibrations, and are post-isolated by means of polyamide-6 capsules with 30% glass fiber, ideal to withstand temperatures close to 155 degrees Celsius.

See technical data sheet

content.rendered:
Its main characteristics are:

  • * Low magnetic field dispersion, minimizing radiated fields.
  • * High performance, allowing energy to be filtered or stored in a minimal space.
  • * Low losses across the entire operating frequency range.
  • * High temperature stability with a range of -50ºC to +90ºC.
  • * Wide frequency range 10kHz to 150kHz.

The family comprises 27 different inductive values, corresponding to the standardized values ​​for passive electronic components, and 11 different cores, resulting in 297 different references that, in most cases, cover design needs. We can manufacture special models with other values ​​or with different core sizes, according to each customer’s specifications.

content.rendered:
What is its elementary function within an electrical system?

These electromagnet coils generate controlled magnetic fields when energized, allowing their use in a wide range of electromagnetic devices and systems. This precise control capability is critical in applications where accurate manipulation of magnetic forces is required.
Enables precise operations in automated systems, improving the accuracy and efficiency of industrial processes. This is especially beneficial in production lines where timing and control are critical to maintaining quality and manufacturing speed.
In addition, they can be integrated into a variety of systems and devices, from heavy machinery to precision equipment, offering customized solutions for different industrial needs.

Why is an electromagnet coil necessary in heavy-duty electrical systems?

They achieve efficient and safe control of the movement of metallic materials, optimizing production processes and improving precision in automated systems. They are highly necessary as they allow activating and deactivating the magnetic force. Especially in environments where fast and controlled handling is required, such as assembly lines, industrial cranes and electromagnetic clamping systems.

In sectors such as metallurgy, automotive and logistics, these coils facilitate tasks such as lifting heavy parts, separating materials and automating transport systems, reducing manual effort and increasing productivity.
In addition, their integration into electromagnetic brakes and clutches ensures greater safety and precision in high-performance machinery. Thanks to their reliability and efficiency, electromagnet coils are a key solution for industries seeking greater control, speed and energy optimization in their operations.

The coils are designed to operate with efficient electricity consumption, ensuring that the energy used is translated into a powerful magnetic field without wasting resources.

Torivac is a company specialized in the design and manufacture of toroidal transformers and voltage regulators.

We have nearly 60 years of experience in the sector, which has allowed us to grow to a presence in more than 30 countries.
We have a technical team that guarantees the manufacture of high precision and efficient devices. Our work methodology allows us to perform advanced simulations at every stage of each project, ensuring that each component, from toroidal voltage variators, adjustable transformers, battery dischargers, potentiometers and toroidal cores, meets the highest industry standards.

We work closely with companies that have a large infrastructure, seeking to guarantee customized and efficient solutions. We aim to respond to the demands of industries such as technology, energy and automotive. Our goal is to continue innovating, strengthening strategic alliances and expanding our global reach, always maintaining the seal of quality and excellence that has characterized us since our beginnings.

excerpt.rendered:
Round reels with central through hole for smooth or stepped shafts. With different cable outlet lengths and designed to withstand the most demanding vibrations.

What are electromagnet coils?

Electromagnet coils are an electromagnetic component consisting of a spirally wound conductive wire, designed to generate a magnetic field when an electric current is applied to it. This field allows attracting or moving metallic objects in a controlled manner, which makes it a key element in lifting systems, industrial automation, electromagnetic brakes and magnetic locks.

Technical guarantee of European encapsulated transformers

Encapsulated series transformers for today’s industrial requirements

The demand for highly reliable electrical components, such as the encapsulated series transformer, has increased significantly in European industry, especially in countries such as Spain, Germany, France and Italy. In these markets, characterized by stringent technical standards and the need for high energy efficiency, having a high quality encapsulated series transformer has become an unavoidable requirement for manufacturers and distributors of regulation and control equipment such as variable voltage drives.

This component not only ensures a more stable and safer operation, but also protects the electrical system from possible overloads or unwanted peaks, thus minimizing downtime and maximizing the overall performance of the facilities.

Within the European industrial sector, there is a commitment to more robust and durable solutions, and the encapsulated series transformer plays a key role in this development.

Its design, which completely isolates the windings by means of encapsulating compounds with high thermal and electrical resistance, improves performance against external agents such as humidity, dust or chemical products that are common in manufacturing environments.

This makes it an essential choice for demanding installations, where any electrical failure can result in significant economic or production losses.
With a compact and safe structure, this type of transformer not only meets current European standards, but also anticipates the industry’s expectations in terms of sustainability and energy efficiency.

Encapsulated series transformer and its value in critical European projects

Torivac has established itself as one of the few European companies specialized in the design and production of encapsulated series transformer with the highest levels of quality, precision and regulatory compliance. With an active presence in Spain and in different strategic points of the continent, this company offers certified solutions in line with the expectations of Industry 4.0, guaranteeing sustainable, safe and continuous operation in high electrical performance applications. Its engineering team develops transformers that not only respond precisely to the technical requirements of each application, but also do so with manufacturing processes oriented towards energy efficiency, mechanical reliability and maximum electromagnetic compatibility.

 

Torivac is its absolute independence from low-quality imported components.

All products, including the encapsulated series transformers, are manufactured with European raw materials and under strict quality control protocols certified by national and international organizations. In addition, the design of the encapsulations is based on resins and epoxy compounds with high electrical insulation, studied to offer superior thermal tolerance even under extreme load conditions. All this makes Torivac the preferred choice for distributors and manufacturers of variable voltage drives looking for durability, reliability and technical support for any operational requirement.

From pre-design consulting to after-sales support and full traceability of its products, Torivac is integrally involved in every phase of the process. The result is an encapsulated series transformer that adapts to the environment of each industry, improving the stability of the electrical system, saving operating costs in the long term and strengthening regulatory compliance in international projects. Its commitment to innovation is reflected in highly efficient, compact, silent and environmentally friendly equipment, developed specifically to meet the demands of the most sophisticated industrial markets in Europe.

Technical and strategic advantages of Torivac’s printed circuit series transformers.

Torivac has established itself as one of the European leaders in the development, manufacture and distribution of high precision transformers, specializing in printed circuit series transformers. Its position in the technical field is due not only to its accumulated experience in the electrical sector, but also to a strong investment in R&D aimed at constantly improving the performance and reliability of its products. Unlike many Asian suppliers, Torivac designs each of its models based on the specific requirements of the European environment, ensuring full compliance with regulations such as RoHS, CE or REACH. Each printed circuit series transformer manufactured by Torivac is subjected to temperature, load and insulation tests, which means a proven operational guarantee, even in environments with high thermal or electromagnetic demands.

Voltage drives used by European integrators are becoming increasingly sophisticated, incorporating digital controls, industrial communication protocols and energy accuracy. Torivac’s transformers are designed precisely to integrate into these environments, facilitating power line stability, harmonic reduction and optimized response under varying load.

The future of industrial energy lies in technical potting

Choosing an encapsulated series transformer manufactured by Torivac means making an intelligent investment that goes beyond economics to become part of the technical and productive strategy of any modern industrial company. In a European context where energy efficiency, downtime reduction and sustainability have become central operating axes, reliable electrical components are essential to ensure competitiveness. This is not only a technical issue, but also a matter of corporate reputation: inefficient equipment or equipment with high failure rates have a direct impact on the end customer experience and the company’s image.

The use of a high quality encapsulated series transformer such as the one developed by Torivac allows achieving superior levels of performance, safety and service life in installations with the presence of voltage variators and other critical control elements. Unlike Asian options with less structural assurance, Torivac’s transformers withstand demanding conditions of humidity, vibration, overload and corrosive environments without compromising performance. This not only translates into fewer technical interventions, but also into a significant competitive advantage for manufacturers and distributors who require total reliability as part of their value proposition.

Collaborating with a company like Torivac should not be seen as a one-off transaction, but as a sustainable partnership over time. Customer commitment, regulatory compliance and applied innovation make Torivac’s encapsulated series transformer not only a technical solution but a strategic asset in the European industrial ecosystem. Given the need for suppliers who understand the specific challenges of the market, working with Torivac ensures operational predictability and constructive excellence, indispensable conditions for advancing in a competitive and increasingly demanding market.

PCB series transformers for industrial applications

Series transformer printed circuit CE certified

In today’s industrial context, electrical accuracy and reliability requirements are more critical than ever, especially among voltage converter manufacturers and specialized distributors in Europe. One of the fundamental components to ensure stability and performance in these systems is the PCB series transformer, whose function goes far beyond simple power transfer.

This type of transformer is specifically designed to be integrated on printed circuit boards, allowing considerable space reduction, improved energy efficiency and a more controlled electromagnetic response.

For demanding markets such as Spain and other parts of Europe, where electrical regulations and quality standards are very stringent, the right supplier and product selection becomes a critical decision for the operational continuity and sustainability of each facility’s electrical system.

A printed circuit series transformer is not a generic component, but a vital part that must meet exacting technical requirements, including insulation, frequency response, mechanical resistance and compatibility with other circuit elements.

Choosing a highly engineered European solution brings tangible and measurable added value over cheaper alternatives from Asian markets. This is especially relevant in industrial applications or environments where electrical reliability defines the profitability of the process. Without a proven quality component, the risk of voltage fluctuations, interference or thermal failure increases considerably, which can result in serious damage to control systems and significant financial losses over time.

Solutions to quality requirements, long-term reliability and compliance with European standards for printed circuit series transformers

The absence of documented traceability, non-standardized quality controls and materials of questionable composition are elements that hinder the safe integration of Asian transformers in projects developed on the European continent. In addition, long logistics times and customs uncertainties further complicate production planning for many manufacturers of integrated variable voltage systems. Another critical point is the limited customization offered by these suppliers, forcing many integrators to modify their PCB design to suit the component, rather than the component being optimized for their system. This not only implies additional engineering costs, but also an increasing risk of technical incompatibilities and extended time-to-market. Under these conditions, it is clear that opting for European manufacturers with solutions specifically developed for the local market brings significant advantages, both from a technical and logistical point of view.

What is a standard conventional transformer and what is its function?

A standard conventional transformer transforms the electrical voltage in industrial and commercial systems, ensuring that power reaches the equipment at the proper voltage. Its main function is to adapt the electrical current to the specific requirements of each application, avoiding fluctuations that could compromise the performance or safety of the installation.

Manufactured with single, symmetrical or multiple output options, Torivac’s conventional transformers adapt to a wide range of requirements. They are ideal for functions such as audio, impedance and 100V line transformers, making them versatile in different environments.

These transformers are essential in the reduction of medium voltage voltages to levels suitable for low voltage distribution networks. They are commonly used in industrial, commercial and residential installations, providing reliable power for machinery, lighting systems and other electrical equipment. Their design allows three-phase banks to be formed, offering flexibility to configure Delta or Star secondaries, adapting to the specific needs of each installation.

What are the functions of the conventional Torivac transformer?

1. Achieve lower maintenance and repair costs: When equipment operates at ideal stress, it wears less, reducing the need for frequent repairs and extending its useful life. This means lower costs for component replacements and fewer production interruptions.

2. Avoid interruptions and production stoppages: In industrial environments, a sudden cut or variation in voltage can stop manufacturing processes, causing economic losses and production delays. A transformer, together with a voltage regulation system, guarantees a continuous and reliable supply, avoiding unexpected failures.

Improve performance in high-precision equipment: In sectors where high-precision equipment is used, such as laboratories, hospitals or data centers, voltage fluctuations can cause errors in measurements, damage to servers or loss of information. Our transformers and stabilizers maintain stable voltage levels to ensure optimal performance and prevent data loss or failure of critical processes.

Differences between a Torivac transformer and any other transformer

A standard transformer fulfills only the voltage conversion function, Torivac transformers are designed with engineering that optimizes energy efficiency, minimizing losses and improving the network. Their construction with high quality materials ensures longer life and resistance to overloads or voltage variations, reducing maintenance costs and risk of operational failures.

In addition, Torivac transformers allow customized configurations in three-phase banks, providing Delta or Star connections according to the specific needs of your project. This flexibility is crucial in industrial sectors where continuity of power supply is a priority.

Torivac is a company specialized in the design and manufacture of conventional and toroidal transformers.

We have nearly 60 years of experience in the sector, which has allowed us to grow to a presence in more than 30 countries.
We have a technical team that guarantees the manufacture of high precision and efficient devices. Our work methodology allows us to perform advanced simulations at every stage of each project, ensuring that each component, from toroidal voltage variators, adjustable transformers, battery dischargers, potentiometers and toroidal cores, meets the highest industry standards.

We work closely with companies that have a large infrastructure, seeking to guarantee customized and efficient solutions. We aim to respond to the demands of industries such as technology, energy and automotive. Our goal is to continue innovating, strengthening strategic alliances and expanding our global reach, always maintaining the seal of quality and excellence that has characterized us since our beginnings.

Why choosing the right three-phase transformer is key?

Within the European industrial landscape, especially in countries such as Spain, Germany and Italy, the role of the three-phase transformer is essential for electrical infrastructure and energy efficiency. This component is fundamental in the efficient distribution of energy in three-phase systems, widely used in automation environments, industrial processes and logistics networks. Its proper implementation not only ensures safety and operational stability, but also contributes to meeting increasing regulatory requirements for energy efficiency. For manufacturers and distributors of medium- and high-voltage equipment, a three-phase transformer is not just a product: it represents a strategic investment with high impact.

Demand in sectors such as electric mobility, renewable energy and AI has transformed this market into a highly specialized technical arena. Expectations in terms of quality, performance and regulatory compliance are higher than ever. In this context, choosing the right three-phase transformer is an operational necessity that directly impacts competitive advantage. Opting for low-quality equipment or equipment that does not comply with European standards entails risks such as operational failures, overheating or even legal sanctions for non-compliance. Accurate choice, therefore, is no longer an option, but an obligation for any serious player in the electrical sector.

Concern about the scarce European manufacturing of three-phase transformers.

The European supply of electrical transformers, especially in medium voltage industrial applications, faces significant challenges. One of the most relevant problems is the lack of reliable European manufacturers with proven capacity to develop specialized equipment such as the three-phase transformer. This shortage has led to an increased reliance on imported products, particularly from Asia, which has intensified doubts about the quality, durability and traceability of these devices. Although certain Chinese manufacturers offer attractive prices, their products often fail to comply with standards such as IEC 60076 or EcoDesign requirements, compromising long-term safety and reliability.

In the European regulatory environment, aspects such as electromagnetic compatibility, mechanical tolerances or thermal behavior are non-negotiable. A transformer that does not meet these parameters can lead to installation failures, legal problems and a significant loss of commercial confidence. Only a few manufacturers in Europe have the necessary expertise to offer solutions that combine precision, energy efficiency and mechanical strength, qualities that cannot be guaranteed by low-cost suppliers.

In addition, the after-sales service offered by these suppliers often lacks the technical level required for critical operations, especially in infrastructure renewal or replacement projects. Sectors such as water treatment, the steel industry or renewable energy conversion require reliability that cannot be compromised.

The three-phase transformer is a technical centerpiece for specialized manufacturers.

Among the few European firms focused on the design and manufacture of highly engineered transformers, Torivac stands out as a technical reference. Specializing in customized solutions and efficiency-oriented manufacturing, this company delivers three-phase transformers capable of exceeding industry standards in aspects such as energy loss, thermal resistance and ease of installation. Each unit includes material certifications, stringent in-house testing and traceability to standards such as ISO 9001 and ISO 14001, ensuring total control from design to final assembly.

For companies operating in automation, high load transmission or renewable integration, choosing a three-phase transformer from Torivac means compatibility with technologies such as harmonic filtering, SCADA integration and hybrid systems. Each unit is matched to customer-specific parameters such as load profile, environmental conditions or network configurations. Thanks to this engineering approach, Torivac significantly reduces commissioning times and improves power quality indicators such as power factor or THDi.

excerpt.rendered:
The rheostats manufactured by Torivac have high heat dissipation and are manufactured from 12W up to a wide range of power ratings in assembled assemblies. These power ratings are applicable with good ventilation conditions. In installations where ventilation is poor, these power ratings should be reduced by up to 20% to avoid overheating.

The core is a ceramic ring of steatite or alumina of high hardness, anti-hygroscopic, thus avoiding corrosion effects by electrolysis. This ring is wound with top quality constantan, nicrom or kanthal wires, depending on the required ohmic value. If not specified in the order, the most suitable material for that value and power is used.

For protection against mechanical damage and to prevent movement of the coils due to expansion caused by heat, these potentiometers are coated with a very hard ceramic cement, manufactured in our laboratories, which withstands temperatures up to 900ºC, allows rapid heat dissipation due to its matte surface and good thermal conductivity.

The cursor contact is usually a silver or polished copper-silver brush.

In addition to linear coils, we can manufacture, upon request, windings with various sections to achieve a non-linear resistive curve.

content.rendered:
Tickets available:

  • Line voltage
  • Phase/neutral voltage
  • Current per phase
  • Control signal 0-10VDC
  • Potentiometer
  • MODBUS

Parameter outputs displayed on the screen

  • Line voltage
  • Phase/neutral voltage
  • Current per phase
  • Active Power
  • Reactive Power
  • Apparent Power
  • Frequency
  • Phi
  • Alarm status

It has 4 programmable relay outputs for alarm management or adjacent systems.

excerpt.rendered:
With this electronic driver you can manage and parameterize the electrical system to which it is connected, allowing to act on the inverter motor taking into account the programmed logic, and the state of the inputs and outputs.
It allows to stabilize the voltage between phases individually acting on three motors simultaneously and adjusting them to the required voltage, achieving a phase difference between voltages <0.5%
This system is programmed according to the needs of each customer so it can be adapted to any adjacent system or make it work as desired, applying ramps up, safety parameters and others.

excerpt.rendered:
It is mainly used to regulate equipment remotely or for stabilizing equipment. It is also recommended to motorize high power voltage variators, due to the ease of use they provide.

In this type of regulation, the drive shaft is driven by a geared motor, by means of a manual switch that allows the output voltage to be raised or lowered.

The motors assembled by TORIVAC have no inertia, making them ideal for remote control.

On request, stabilized models are manufactured by means of our own electronics with an accuracy of 2%.

See technical data sheet

Toroidal transformers as an electromagnetic efficiency solution in Spain and Europe

Importance of the TT series transformer in today’s European marketAsEurope experiences an increasing demand for efficient and reliable power solutions, the TT series transformer is consolidating its position as one of the most recommended technical options for voltage equipment manufacturers and distributors.

This type of transformer plays a key role in industrial infrastructures that require precision, durability and compliance with demanding standards.

In countries such as Spain, Germany or Italy, energy efficiency and sustainability policies demand highly stable equipment with high electrical performance, characteristics of the technology incorporated in the TT series transformer.

Its robust design and ability to adapt to different voltage environments make it a fundamental component in industrial electrical systems, both in new installations and in the modernization of existing infrastructures.

Specifically, it provides high operational reliability in sectors where power quality allows no margin for error, such as railways, hospitals, logistics and automated manufacturing.

In addition, the TT series transformer’s compatibility with EN standards and European directives considerably reduces implementation and project approval times.

The increasingly stringent European regulatory environment for electrical components requires products to meet safety, efficiency and electromagnetic compatibility requirements, which has prompted the development of transformers designed to excel in this technical environment.

Specialized European manufacturers, such as Torivac, choose to maintain a centralized production cycle in Europe, using certified materials and strictly controlled processes. The traceability, factory testing and projected service life of components such as the TT Series Transformer far exceed the parameters offered by generic non-EU alternatives.

This means lower failure rates, better thermal response, ideal adaptation to variable loads and reduced electromagnetic interference, which is crucial in high-level automation installations. For technical buyers and industrial maintenance managers, these elements should be central to their purchasing decision, well above the initial price.

With more than two decades of experience in the electrical industry, Torivac has established itself as a leader in voltage technology, implementing European standards without compromising innovation. Its product line includes the TT series transformer, designed specifically for installation engineering and applications requiring stable performance in the face of power fluctuations.

What distinguishes this series is not only its operational reliability, but also its adaptability to the specific requirements of each customer, through customized manufacturing with competitive delivery times.

In addition, Torivac has in-house electrical testing laboratories that guarantee rigorous control at all stages of assembly.

The Torivac TT Series Transformer offers advantages that cannot be matched.

Its passive cooling system, precision winding and dielectric coating applied with automated in-plant systems ensure sustained operation even under extreme overload conditions.

This type of technical investment translates into fewer operational interruptions and longer service life for industrial systems already in operation. The confidence of European engineering companies and distributors in Torivac is not only due to the quality of its components, but also to the after-sales technical support that includes direct guidance by specialist electronics engineers.

Adopting the right solution from the outset can mean the difference between stable operating costs or the abrupt onset of unpredictable failures.

In this sense, Torivac and its TT series Transformer are positioned as a rational and strategic choice for those who prioritize security of power supply and technical compliance with European laws.

Collaborating with a manufacturer that masters the EU regulatory language and is familiar with the technical needs of local distribution networks translates into a more viable and sustainable project. Making the right choice in a market saturated with products of dubious origin should not only depend on the purchase price, but also on fundamental variables such as avoided downtime, ease of integration and regulatory compliance.

The Torivac TT series transformer does not respond to a logic of volume but of precision, reliability and applied engineering. This focused design strategy has enabled the brand to maintain a portfolio of recurring customers in technologically demanding sectors, demonstrating a real commitment to European quality.

Overcoming the technical challenges of a constantly evolving electrical infrastructure starts with choosing approved suppliers with a working philosophy aligned with industry best practices. For purchasing and electrical engineering managers, having access to experts who understand technical standards, voltage combinations and complex load requirements is a key differentiator.

Torivac offers not only products but also a constant technical dialogue, becoming a trusted partner at every stage of the project. With the TT Series Transformer, this relationship goes beyond mere supply and becomes a lasting synergy based on shared knowledge.

Making informed technical decisions not only protects industrial investments, but also strengthens the foundations of a resilient electrical system, adapted to the new requirements of electric mobility, distributed generation and digitization of processes. If what you are looking for is a transformer that delivers today and tomorrow, with real performance guarantees, the most sensible choice is to opt for the proven quality that Torivac has been perfecting for years. In an environment where technical decisions affect the entire value chain, relying on the TT Series Transformer is not just another option: it is a clear demonstration of commitment to operational excellence.

excerpt.rendered:
This TT series transformer is manufactured with a 230V primary and two identical secondaries, which allow to duplicate voltages or currents, connecting them in series or parallel, in a range of powers between 20VA and 220VA, supplied with individual boxes and mounting accessories.

Series connection:
Connecting yellow with white we will obtain double voltage between red and black, at the rated current.

Parallel connection:
Connecting red with white and yellow with black we will obtain the rated voltage with double current.Standard length of outputs: 20 cm.

excerpt.rendered:
Designed to achieve the best value for money, it allows to control the voltage variators remotely, through a PLC or PC.

Microprocessor control electronics, self-designed, facilitates the stabilization of the output voltage with an analog setpoint of 0-10VDC.

Includes 7-segment display without backlighting provides us with the reading voltage with an accuracy of 1%, configurable by buttons not accessible to the end user.

content.rendered:
Contributions of the Torivac three-phase motorized inverter

A Torivac three-phase motorized inverter is a device designed to regulate and adjust the output voltage in three-phase electrical systems, allowing precise voltage control according to the needs of the installation. Its basic function is to stabilize the power supplied to electric motors and industrial machinery, avoiding power surges or dips that may affect performance and operating efficiency.
In highly demanding environments, its use is key to optimize power consumption, extend equipment life and improve safety in the energy infrastructure.
It is located between the motor and the equipment’s voltage source. It powers, regulates and controls an AC motor. Inverters usually have an efficiency between 95% and 98%, which implies a considerable reduction in the energy consumption of the motors and consequently a reduction in costs.

What is a motorized three-phase drive used for?

High power sinusoidal power supplies
Power control in linear loads.
When we need to perform tests with under or over voltage
When the process requires a stable electrical power source and a constant supply.

Provides stability and better synchronization in the operational processes of large energy industries.

The motorized three-phase drive allows the output voltage to be precisely adjusted, which is essential in applications requiring stability and synchronization.
In automated production lines, for example, it ensures that machines operate with a voltage adjusted as needed, avoiding failures due to mismatches in the temperature of a tank or in the current of a galvanic bath. In the food industry, where processes must meet quality standards, this control capability is key to the consistency of the final product.

This drive protects the system against voltage spikes and load variations, preventing damage and ensuring stable operation. In industrial environments with changing power grids, this protection is essential to avoid unexpected interruptions and failures.
It is designed for integration in various sectors, from air conditioning systems to heavy machinery. In logistics and transportation, it optimizes the performance of conveyor belts, ensuring an efficient flow of materials.

Torivac is a company specialized in the design and manufacture of toroidal transformers and voltage regulators.

We have nearly 60 years of experience in the industry, which has allowed us to grow to a presence in more than 30 countries.
We have a technical team that guarantees the manufacture of high precision and efficient devices. Our work methodology allows us to perform advanced simulations in each phase of each project, ensuring that each component, from toroidal voltage variators, adjustable transformers, battery dischargers, potentiometers and toroidal cores, meet the highest standards in the industry.
We work closely with companies that have a large infrastructure, seeking to ensure customized and efficient solutions. We aim to respond to the demands of industries such as technology, energy and automotive. Our goal is to continue innovating, strengthening strategic alliances and expanding our global reach, always maintaining the seal of quality and excellence that has characterized us since our beginnings.

It is mainly used to regulate equipment remotely or for stabilizing equipment. It is also recommended to motorize high power voltage variators, due to the ease of use they provide.

In this type of regulation, the drive shaft is driven by a geared motor, by means of a manual switch that allows the output voltage to be raised or lowered.

The motors assembled by TORIVAC have no inertia, making them ideal for remote control.

On request, stabilized models are manufactured by means of our own electronics with an accuracy of 2% (link to control accessories).
